I chose Wordpress.com to host my blog because I'm not very good at coding and it was pretty straight forward. Anyone else use any other host and what made you choose that one?

I use Siteground Cloud Hosting, but their Shared hosting is pretty good. You can see a decent review here (https://www.besthostnews.com/siteground-review/) that links to resources \ hangouts and stuff talking about some of the features, especially with their Supercacher (speeds up your site). The most important thing though is that support response times are measured in minutes.

Another host I have used and liked is Hostnine \ A Small Orange (they are the same company). However, I am finding that support is not as good as it used to be, which ultimately made me move away. They are still better than most though.

I personally use DreamHost and have been with them since '07. Affordable pricing, reliable uptime, great customer service, easy to use admin panel. I was originally referred to them by Justin Dike, the guy who runs Cartoon Smart back in my Flash days.

I'm very happy with 1&1. I have an affiliate link and I won't even post if here because I love them so much. Their UI is terrible, but their services offered are amazing for the price. I can have unlimited emails, unlimited subdomains, and private registration for no additional charge. Their hosting is fairly reliable. I think I've seen it down once ever on my sites. They actively work to improve their products too. Anyway, check it out if you're interested in those kinds of things.
